text:
Carlos M: Quick poll for anyone commuting to Canary Wharf next week — best grab-and-go for a 20-min lunch?
Nora: Canary Wharf shoutout: The Breakfast Club near Jubilee is surprisingly quick for sandwiches. avoids the tourist lines.
Priya S: If you want something lighter, Pret on Canada Square is fastest. they have decent soup and salad pots, under 5 min if you use the app.
Ben H: For something proper: Docklands Fish + Chips on Poplar High St is worth the 10-min walk. takes ~15 min but solid.
Carlos M: Nice. Also, any quick airport recs for BCN? layover next month, ~50min.
Nora: At BCN, the empanada stand near gate E3 is reliable and fast. avoid the sit-down tapas unless you have >90 min.
Priya S: Barcelona tip: El Corte InglE9s food floor (if you get into city) has great tapas counters; but not for short layovers.
Ben H: For London City Airport, the bakery by security usually has fresh sausage rolls and wraps. good for tight connections.
Carlos M: Thanks! Will use Pret if Im tight. Also thinking of starting a tiny travel-recs doc in #lunch-plans for quick airport hacks.
TacoBot: :taco: Poll: "Todays lunch mood: sandwich / salad / comfort / surprise" (react to vote)
Nora: +1 for the doc. can we add a column for how long the queue typically is (5/10/20+)? huge factor.
Priya S: yes please. also an allergens checkbox. i'll add a few Lisbon and Tokyo quick picks later.
Ben H: If someone wants to try Docklands fish friday, i'll grab extra portions and share at 12:30 in the kitchen island.
Carlos M: Perfect. 12:30 meet and doc created. tagging @TacoBot for a reminder. :shipit:
